subtitle: English Basics
teachers:
BEAN Casey
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: English Basics is a four-skills (reading, writing, speaking, listening) course designed to help students acquire basic English grammar and vocabulary and become more comfortable speaking English through extensive practice. Students will learn and practice basic grammar patterns through group work, pair work, short writing assignments, and presentations. Students will also learn effective techniques for studying English at the college level.
advice:
This course will cover the following topics:
Unit 1: Be verb
Units 2: Questions with be-verb
Unit 4: Simple present tense
Unit 6: WH- questions
Unit 10: Past tense

Classes will consist of active learning activities that practice reading, writing, speaking, and listening, as well as extensive group and pair work.
Before each class, students must complete homework assignments on Moodle.

activityGoals.body: Students will increase their knowledge of basic English grammar.
Students will increase their knowledge of basic English vocabulary.
Students will increase their ability to write basic English sentences.
Students will become more comfortable communicating verbally in English.
Students will learn practical skills for effectively studying English.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. Students will be able to perfectly use the grammar points studied in class.
2. Students will be able to perfectly use all of the vocabulary studied in class.
3. Students will be able to accurately use the grammar points and vocabulary studied in class to write basic English sentences.
4. Students will be able to speak with confidence using the grammar points and vocabulary studied in class.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Students will be able to use the grammar points studied in class with some mistakes.
2. Students will be able to use most of the vocabulary studied in class.
3. Students will be able to use the grammar points and vocabulary studied in class to write basic English sentences with some mistakes.
4. Students will be able to speak using the grammar points and vocabulary studied in class.

              English Basics is a four-skills (reading, writing, speaking, listening) course designed to help students acquire basic English grammar and vocabulary and become more comfortable speaking English through extensive practice. Students will learn and practice basic grammar patterns through group work, pair work, short writing assignments, and presentations. Students will also learn effective techniques for studying English at the college level.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course will cover the following topics:
Unit 1: Be verb
Units 2: Questions with be-verb
Unit 4: Simple present tense
Unit 6: WH- questions
Unit 10: Past tense

Classes will consist of active learning activities that practice reading, writing, speaking, and listening, as well as extensive group and pair work.
Before each class, students must complete homework assignments on Moodle.
